name: LANES-4: an own job gets the owner's login environment
description: The owner's login shell exports a Bedrock gateway, its model, CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK and other CLAUDE_* names: an own Claude Code job gets each as written and obid passes no --model; what pushes (SSH_AUTH_SOCK, GH_TOKEN, GIT_CONFIG_*) stays out. A job marked untrusted gets none of them and obid's model.

inputs.text:
#!/bin/sh
# The owner's login shell: the scratch obid's own PATH, and what their ~/.zprofile exports.
PATH=$(sed -n "s/^PATH='\(.*\)'$/\1/p" '${state.o.folder}/login-shell')
export PATH ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://gateway.example/bedrock CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK=1 ANTHROPIC_MODEL=us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5-v1:0 SSH_AUTH_SOCK=/tmp/agent.sock GH_TOKEN=not-a-token GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=1 GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0=credential.helper GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0=store LANES_4=kept CLAUDE_CODE_LANES_21=kept
exec /usr/bin/env -0

summary.$contains: ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://gateway.example/bedrock CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK=1 ANTHROPIC_MODEL=us.anthropic.claude-sonnet-5-5-v1:0 SSH_AUTH_SOCK=none GH_TOKEN=none GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=none LANES_4=kept CLAUDE_CODE_LANES_21=kept model=none
ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=none CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK=none ANTHROPIC_MODEL=none SSH_AUTH_SOCK=none GH_TOKEN=none GIT_CONFIG_COUNT=none LANES_4=none CLAUDE_CODE_LANES_21=none model=claude-
